contribution_boundary: These checks improve evaluation validity and mechanism interpretation. They cannot guarantee an advantage over late fusion or turn an incremental architecture into a methodologically novel one.

budget_alternative.condition: Choose seed budget before any outer outcomes; do not add seeds selectively based on observed significance.

internal_evaluation.fixed_training_recipe: Keep existing architecture, transforms, loss and sampler recipe, optimizer settings, epoch cap 150 and patience 15. Fit age normalization, class counts, and SCC sampler weights on each inner training partition only.
internal_evaluation.initialization: Each fit starts from the same verified ImageNet V2 pretrained backbone and fresh trainable modules; no reuse of PAD-trained checkpoints.

inner_selection.method: One patient-disjoint stratified holdout, approximately 20% of each outer development portion
inner_selection.outer_test_access: No early stopping, preprocessing, loss or sampling estimates, hyperparameter selection, or architecture changes based on outer scores.
inner_selection.purpose: Early stopping only; no hyperparameter search

interpretation: This is outer grouped cross-validation with an inner early-stopping holdout, not a full nested hyperparameter search.
Historical reuse of PAD in architecture development remains a limitation; this is retrospective internal validation, not a newly untouched cohort.
The previous external evaluation remains unchanged; no evaluation or model selection on DermatoNet is needed for these new CV fits.

outer_split.method: StratifiedGroupKFold with patient and duplicate grouping

proposed_pool.requirement: Rebuild and verify patient IDs and exact duplicate groups before locking folds; do not inherit a claim that old holdout was untouched.

internal_evaluation.purpose: Out-of-fold internal performance for a now-fixed training pipeline, separate from early-stopping/model-tuning performance.
report: Image-level pooled out-of-fold BACC per seed, with patients kept in one outer fold; do not average multiple lesions into one label without a new definition.
Internal full-minus-late-fusion BACC as main supplemental comparison; full-minus-image-only as secondary.
Per-class recall including MEL support; NLL and Brier.

Paired patient-cluster bootstrap intervals conditional on the frozen out-of-fold models, with training-seed variability reported separately. Do not treat folds or repeated predictions as independent patients.

checks: Use each frozen checkpoint training age statistics, not external-cohort statistics.
A must reproduce locked observed predictions within tolerance 0.0002 before interpreting interventions.
F must reproduce the previous all-metadata-missing construction.
Images, patient order, labels and checkpoints remain fixed; retain per-patient outputs.
missingness_encoding.interpretation: Input-encoding sensitivity; not proof of clinical missingness robustness or causal information contribution. Training age-missing flag was always zero.
main_contrasts: C minus B: flag encoding effect at median age, observed sex
F minus E: flag encoding effect at median age, unknown sex
metrics: ECE with 10 bins if reported, aligned with current main paper
other_contrasts: B minus A: age neutralization; if any observed ages are already missing, also report the observed-age subset separately
E minus A: combined neutralization with age flag zero

new_cloud_actions: Execution authorized; see controller progress for actual state.
order: Lock the supplemental protocol and validate inputs locally.
Run missingness decomposition and 100 repeated permutations together using frozen models.
Run the prechosen 45- or 75-fit internal evaluation separately after its fold audit.
Report all results and update claims regardless of direction.

repeated_permutations.implementation: Separate extension module and outputs; reuse existing inference feature caching after observed-prediction reproduction. Do not modify the locked eight-scenario script.
repeated_permutations.index_rule: For each repetition, derive three independent RNG streams from the repetition seed; save ordered patient IDs, permutation indices, and hashes before inference. Reuse exactly the same permutations across all models and training seeds.
repeated_permutations.interpretation: Reliance of already fitted models on metadata associations in an already examined cohort; post hoc exploratory sensitivity, not intrinsic or causal feature importance.
report: Mean BACC delta per seed and scenario over 100 shuffles.
Permutation variability and Monte Carlo standard error separately from variation across five trained seeds.
Within-repetition paired model-difference contrasts, with no treatment of 100 shuffles as new patients or training runs.
If patient bootstrap intervals are computed, pair model outputs and describe conditioning on the fixed permutations and trained models.

scenario_blocks.age: age value plus missing indicator together
scenario_blocks.joint: all five metadata columns as one row, preserving age-sex dependence

scope: Three supplemental evidence checks. Original study results are already known. No new confirmatory primary claim or independent external cohort is created.
storage_policy: All new 75 checkpoints retained on persistent cloud project disk with SHA256 inventory. Small verified result archives created; full checkpoint off-host retrieval is a separate pending verification, avoiding an 8 GiB duplicate archive on the instance.
